purpose: determine whether official Combo collateral return preserves the exact statewise payoff of independently existing compatible positions while releasing pUSD early, before any market-data or account request

novelty_boundary.existing_rank_33_use: collateral return was previously retained only as Combo RFQ decomposition residual-inventory and plan-workflow evidence
novelty_boundary.distinct_question: whether an already-held compatible position has a deterministic exposure-preserving collateral-release right whose opportunity-cost value is direction independent
novelty_boundary.not_a_new_family_if_proved: route the result as a capital-efficiency overlay joining existing rank-33 Combo mechanics and rank-1 idle-pUSD holding economics rather than duplicating either mechanism

source.endpoint_classification: public unauthenticated static official documentation page; not an account market order quote or state-changing endpoint

source_questions: which exact position combinations are compatible and how compatibility is determined
what tokens or positions are consumed created or retained by the operation
whether every terminal outcome payoff is preserved before and after collateral return
how much pUSD is released and whether a remainder or residual position remains
whether the plan or execution endpoint requires authentication account state or a transaction
which fees gas relayer latency rounding failure and reversal costs are documented

decision_rules.reject_source_stage: reject if exact exposure preservation release quantity eligibility or cost semantics are absent conflicting or conditional on acquiring new inventory
decision_rules.candidate_only: retain a candidate only for independently existing compatible positions and only if the source proves exact statewise exposure preservation plus positive released pUSD; source evidence alone cannot prove after-cost value
decision_rules.economic_escalation: after a source pass freeze one zero-network opportunity-cost inequality using no account inventory and no market data
decision_rules.promotion_boundary: no accepted or deployment-ready edge without exact owned eligibility quantities operation cost realized state transition and a positive independently available use of released pUSD

stop_rules: make exactly one documentation request and do not follow links
do not request Combo quotes catalogs books fees accounts balances plans execution endpoints or transactions
do not assume that plan generation or gasless execution is free or authorized
do not count collateral release as profit or double-count the released principal
preserve failures and do not rerun this source contract
